reason: Relocation assistance for no-fault evictions is a substantive just-cause protection, not notice-only, so keep the rule. Corrected end_date to null: 2/28/2027 is the end of the annual rate period, not a sunset (rule 1); the period is now in key_value. 2026-03-01 is the rate period start, not the law's effective date, and the document states none, so effective_date is null. Citation changed to the name the document uses ('Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C'); 'S.F. Admin. Code' is not in the text (rule 5).

rule.title: Relocation payments for no-fault evictions (owner move-in, demolition, capital improvement, rehab)
rule.requirement: If you are evicted in San Francisco for an owner or relative move-in, demolition or removal of the unit, capital improvement work, or substantial rehab, your landlord must pay you $8,245 per tenant (up to $24,733 per unit), plus $5,497 more for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children, for notices served 3/1/2026-2/28/2027.
rule.requirement_es: Si lo desalojan en San Francisco porque el dueño o un familiar se muda, por demolición o retiro de la unidad, por obras de mejora de capital o por rehabilitación sustancial, el propietario debe pagarle $8,245 por inquilino (hasta $24,733 por unidad), más $5,497 por cada inquilino mayor (60+) o discapacitado u hogar con hijos menores, para avisos entregados del 1/3/2026 al 28/2/2027.
rule.key_value: $8,245 per tenant; max $24,733 per unit; +$5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor children (for eviction notices served 3/1/2026-2/28/2027)
rule.coverage_text: Evictions in San Francisco based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work (20 days or more), or substantial rehabilitation; amounts based on date the eviction notice is served.

applies_if.value_text: eviction based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation

exemptions.label: Temporary capital improvement evictions under 20 days (governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9)

all.value_text: temporary capital improvement eviction for less than 20 days
